analysis: Descriptive profiles: all196. Outcome associations: fixed TRAIN only. One feature per adjusted model. No comparison refitting or cutpoint search.
stage: Six pattern fractions; advanced III/IV vs I/II logistic adjusted age, sex, histology, TLS presence/density/area.
survival: Six frozen pattern fractions plus eight listed morphology concepts x four endpoints; cancer-stratified Efron Cox adjusted age, sex, stage II, stage III/IV, TLS presence/density/area; feature clipped1–99% and scaled by SD.
composition: Core/rim soft densities multiplied by their exact raster areas, then normalized over nine mapped coarse groups. Other probability mass is excluded; these are conditional model composition, not observed cell frequencies. TLS equally weighted within patient; patients equally weighted in summaries.
families: BH separately over24 pattern-survival,32 morphology-survival and6 stage tests. These descriptive-family q values do not account for earlier adaptive discovery.
